connector.name: SkillsSafe Security Scanner
connector.registryDescription: AI skill security scanner. Detects prompt injection, credential theft, ClawHavoc. Free, no signup.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.skillssafe.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package skillssafe-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.skillssafe. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
